<p><b>PART I</b></p>
<p><b>Item 1. Business</b></p>
<p>Example Corp sells prepackaged software to small businesses in the United States.</p>
<p><b>Item 1A. Risk Factors</b></p>
<p>Our results depend on a small number of large customers. The loss of one customer would reduce revenue.</p>
<p>We face strong competition from larger vendors with greater resources.</p>
<p><b>Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments</b></p>
<p>None.</p>
<p><b>Item 2. Properties</b></p>
<p>We lease one office in Springfield, Illinois.</p>
<p><b>PART II</b></p>
<p><b>Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations</b></p>
<p>Revenue grew twenty percent in 2025 because existing customers bought more seats.</p>
<p>Liquidity remained adequate; we hold no debt.</p>
<p><b>Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data</b></p>
<p>See the consolidated financial statements that follow.</p>
